paragraphs.text: The Patron of the Kitsune is a kami from Kamigawa that was active during the Kami War . It is the great Patron Kami of the Kitsune .

The kami's appearance is that of a giant white beast, with eight arms ending in black, clawed hands. Its face is dominated by its giant muzzle, and large lanterns float around its head. It is known to eat Kitsune as offerings.
